description: IAS Signal video tag on unified.adsafeprotected.com/v2/{advertiserId}/{publisherId}. Both IDs ride in the path. Display tags on pixel.adsafeprotected.com are vendor/ias.

params.name: advertiser_id
params.description: It is the IAS advertiser ID. Microsoft documents the IAS-generated video Tag URL as unified.adsafeprotected.com/v2/{advertiserId}/{publisherId}.
params.fix_hint: Copy the Tag URL from IAS Signal Tag Manager so the path is /v2/{advertiserId}/{publisherId}.

params.name: publisher_id
params.description: It is the IAS publisher ID. Microsoft documents it as the second path segment on the video Tag URL.
params.fix_hint: Keep both path segments from the IAS Signal tag. The second is the publisher ID.
